verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs explicitly describe real-time, incremental streaming of agent and workflow outputs, plus AI SDK-compatible stream conversion (toAISdkStream), and separate observability docs confirm visibility into every agent run, workflow step, and tool call, which together support streaming both tokens and intermediate events to a UI. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation specifically of tool-call/step event streaming (only overview-level docs), and no explicit code example showing UI consumption of these events.
